action.message:
Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In `ModelAdmin.changelist_view`, the list_editable POST bulk-edit processing (the loop that saves each changed form via `save_form`/`save_model`/`save_related`/`log_change`) is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`. This ensures the multi-object bulk edit is committed atomically, preventing partial/unexpected database states if an error occurs mid-processing. `transaction` and `router` were already imported at the top of the file, so no import changes were needed.

Verification: scoped_tests passed — 74 tests ran with 0 failures (selection: admin_changelist).
